name: XRF V2
summary: Multimodal continuous daily-activity dataset for temporal action localization and action summarization in smart-home rooms.

hardware.platform: WiFi receiver array plus phone, watch, earbud and glasses IMUs and Azure Kinect

settings.scenario: Dining room, study room, and bedroom; 7–10 actions per sequence

standardization.notes: Preserve every continuous 50 Hz source sequence and all 34 raw temporal label intervals. The default task view resamples only time to 100 Hz and splits it into 300-step windows. Keep 30 subcarriers and both released 3-valued receiver/channel axes, represented as [T,S,Tx,Rx] with an explicit logical-axis caveat.
